INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

5. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.

7. When practising Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Poetry.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

9. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

10. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Narratives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
